reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for Neighbourhood and Enlargement Negotiations

title.narrative: Enhancing international police cooperation against migrant smuggling in North Africa - Project HIMAYA

description.narrative:
Project HIMAYA aims to prevent, counter and dismantling Smuggling of Migrants (SoM) and Trafficking in Human Beings (THB) networks in North Africa. The project will foster regional cooperation among police and law enforcement agencies in North Africa and beyond, specifically targeting smuggling and trafficking networks. While the project directly targets Algeria, Egypt, Libya, Morocco, and Tunisia, other countries will be involved due to the transnational nature of the crime domain and the migration routes. The project is structured around three main pillars:

1.  Capacity building

2.     Technical support

3.     Operational support and operations coordination
